method: Searched with the user-requested search-service connector. Primary sources preferred. Event dates and publication dates are separate. Sources establish external events, not their causal effect on anonymized cafe transactions. The assignment describes real transaction data with replaced IDs; SYN prefixes do not establish synthetic generation.
critical_corrections: The renewed Lebanon escalation began on 2026-03-02, not March 1.
The temporary ceasefire took effect on 2026-04-17 local time. This is a regime change, not an end-of-war or normal-business indicator; hostilities and displacement persisted afterwards.
The 2026 Easter dates differ: Western April 5 and Eastern April 12; actual holiday and school closure windows extend around these Sundays.
Ramadan began February 18 under Dar el Fatwa's declaration; some authorities began February 19. Run a one-day sensitivity check. Do not infer individual religion from purchases or branch names.
Official Eid al-Fitr public-sector closure was extended through March 23; Eid al-Adha closure was May 27-29. Cafe opening hours need separate verification.
A single Beirut weather grid cannot establish weather at anonymized Harbour, Garden and Uptown. Public brand listings do not provide a defensible mapping from those labels to real branches.
Six months includes winter, spring and early summer only. It cannot identify repeatable annual seasonality or prove the effect of a holiday observed once.
Historical realized weather is suitable for explanatory analysis but gives an optimistic backtest for next-day decisions; use forecasts actually available at decision time.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Within-month temperature/rain anomalies after weekday and trend control; branch/category interactions; rolling holdout ablation.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Change pastry preparation, iced-drink ingredients and staffing by predicted demand distribution; test takeaway offers during rain.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Branch coordinates, opening hours, stockouts, forecast archive and waste.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Local-sunset-relative daypart shifts, separate Western/Eastern and civic holidays, one-day lunar sensitivity, leave-one-event-out robustness.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Move preparation and staffing to observed evening window; test seasonal bundles on incremental gross profit.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Accurate store hours, at least another comparable year, campaign logs; no customer religion needed.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Geocoded branch exposure and access logs; lagged local incidents; compare disrupted and receiving areas only if pre-trends and controls are credible.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Adjust operating plans and replenish available branches; override automated forecasts when access changes.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Alias/address mapping, closures, delivery reach, dated local incident/displacement data.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Class/exam/online/holiday periods interacted with verified campus catchment and daypart.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Study-period snack/coffee prep and staffing; avoid overstock when classes move online.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Catchment mapping and historical modality announcements.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Kickoff windows at screening branches versus nonscreening controls; control weekday/time/trend and run placebo windows.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Reservation-based staffing and snack bundles evaluated on gross profit per seat-hour.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Actual branch screening calendar, reservations, seat capacity, event promotions.

candidate_tests_and_actions.test: Month-end/first-week indicators as hypotheses, verified payroll dates where relevant; compare promotion availability and POS outages before news explanations.
candidate_tests_and_actions.action_if_validated: Schedule profitable offers and inventory using validated demand changes.
candidate_tests_and_actions.minimum_additional_data: Company campaign, loyalty, delivery-app availability, stockout, operating-hour and outage logs. No external fact or current effect asserted.

causal_and_model_rules: A news event on a high-sales date is a hypothesis, not an explanation. Compare the residual against a pre-event calendar/trend baseline.
Register the feature families and action rules before scanning residual peaks; control false discoveries across branch/category/event tests.
Use date-blocked uncertainty or temporal holdouts because branches share the same 181 weather/calendar days; 543 branch-days are not 543 independent external shocks.
Separate retrospective explanations from features available before each forecast origin, and retain known_at timestamps for event feeds.
Profit optimization needs unit contribution margins, waste/salvage, lead times, stockouts and capacity; transaction sales alone do not reveal uncensored demand.

A valid null result should remove an external feature from the model. The assignment describes real data with replaced transaction IDs; SYN prefixes do not prove synthetic generation. Unusual regularity should trigger provenance checks rather than a claim that the data is artificial.
